decision: Prepare 512px contextual presentation renditions for all 32 currently available rescue friends and all 12 current enemies from their approved immutable generator masters. The Human's v0.21.0 comparison requests substantially larger, crisp friend inspection and Adventure Book artwork. This resolution-only work preserves established identities and does not reopen any art approval.
selection: All friend rows and active enemy rows from the immutable Plan03 map, plus Garden Goblin v02 from the post-v0201 refresh. Current strict source records must each be approved and active. Historical dormant placement rows do not override subsequent approved placement checkpoints.
preserve: Rebuild every existing optical derivative byte-for-byte before preparing a higher-resolution rendition. Preserve approved extraction, family-specific registration, grounded versus floating geometry, Candy Mimic's item/state-family metadata, original sources and approval evidence. Never upscale the 256px runtime file. Load large derivatives only in visible contextual presentation.
publicationGate: Preparation is not acceptance. A separate exact-byte root publication approval and explicit measured media allocation are required before release. Preserve old source records and runtime files as rollback material.
